 Frontend:

 Angular 21 (Mandatory): Strong hands-on experience in Angular 21 development, including Angular 10+ versions, TypeScript, components, services, directives, pipes, routing, reactive forms, dependency injection, and state management.

 Angular Ecosystem: Experience with NgRx, RxJS, Angular Material, and integration of Angular applications with RESTful APIs.

 UI Development: Proficiency in developing responsive, scalable, and user-friendly web applications using Angular, HTML5, CSS3, SASS/SCSS, and JavaScript.

 Strong knowledge of JavaScript, Angular, and AngularJS. 

 Frontend Architecture: Understanding of component-based architecture, performance optimization, lazy loading, module federation, and frontend security best practices.

 Accessibility & Testing: Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG), unit testing frameworks such as Jasmine/Karma, and end-to-end testing tools.

 Expertise and Skills Required 

 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline

 6–10 years of proven success designing technical solutions and hands-on development experience using Java 25 

 Strong back-end application development expertise, with extensive experience in Java 25, Spring Boot, and Spring Security 

 Experience with CockroachDB is a plus

 Hands-on experience designing and building APIs , including integration with API Gateways 

 Strong knowledge of authentication and authorization technologies and best practices (highly preferred)

 Comprehensive understanding of the software development lifecycle , including requirements analysis, design, development, unit, functional and integration testing, test automation, debugging, troubleshooting, and issue resolution

 Experience designing and implementing secure, scalable, and highly available enterprise-grade systems on Amazon Web Services (AWS) 

 Experience building container-based systems , with hands-on knowledge of Docker , Kubernetes , and managed orchestration platforms such as EKS 

 Proven ability to design systems using modern distributed architecture patterns 

 Demonstrated critical thinking and complex problem-solving skills

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills , with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering and architecture teams

 Experience working in an Agile development environment 

 Familiarity with the following tools and technologies is a plus: Git, Maven, Jenkins, Jira 

 Proven experience developing microservices-based architectures using RESTful APIs

Those laws and regulations may restrict Fidelity from hiring and/or associating with individuals with certain Criminal Histories.

 Updated Key Skills and Technologies Backend:

 
 Java

 Spring Boot

 Hibernate/JPA

 SQL

 Microservices Architecture

 REST APIs

 Fraud Prevention Experience ( Mandatory )

 
 Frontend:

 
 Angular (10+ preferred)

 TypeScript

 JavaScript

 AngularJS

 HTML5, CSS3, SASS/SCSS

 NgRx

 RxJS

 Angular Material

 REST API Integration

 Responsive UI Development

 
 Good to Have:

 
 Docker

 CI/CD Pipelines

 Kubernetes

 Unit Testing & Automation Testing

 Cloud Platforms (Azure/AWS)

 
 Mandatory Requirements: 

 
 Strong experience in Angular development and architecture .

 Strong experience with Java, Spring Boot, and Microservices .

 Fraud Prevention domain experience is mandatory. 

  

 


 
 
 
 
 
 Compensation, Benefits and Duration 

 Minimum Compensation: USD 39,000

 Maximum Compensation: USD 137,000

 Compensation is based on actual experience and qualifications of the candidate. The above is a reasonable and a good faith estimate for the role.

 Medical, vision, and dental benefits, 401k retirement plan, variable pay/incentives, paid time off, and paid holidays are available for full time employees.

 This position is not available for independent contractors

 No applications will be considered if received more than 120 days after the date of this post
